Does the company report on the scope or boundaries of its sustainability disclosure? 
o 
Yes, the company reports on the scope or boundaries of its sustainability disclosure. Please indicate where this information is available in public 
reporting or corporate website. 
o 
All activities fully consolidated for financial reporting purposes are covered 
o 
The following percentage of the company's revenues is covered by its sustainability disclosure: 
Dropdown menu: 
75%-100% 
50%-75% 
25%-50% 
0-25% 
o 
All activities under operational control and/or majority-owned are covered 
o 
None of the above applies, but the company provides the criteria used for sustainability data disclosure (e.g., a list of included or excluded 
entities, geographies or divisions) 
o 
No, the company does not report on the scope or boundaries of its sustainability disclosure, but has disclosed the coverage of some specific 
environmental or social indicators. Please indicate where this information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
□ 
Some environmental indicators have coverage details 
□ 
Some social indicators have coverage details
noteZh: 结构：主问题“是否披露”为单选；“是”分支下设边界范围单选组（含收入覆盖比例下拉）；“否”分支下环境指标和社会指标覆盖为两个复选项。边界手册数据要求另有“single-choice section 中可选择多个选项”的条件表述，因此线上实际允许的多选行为仍需门户验证；本结构按题面圆圈和本任务指定的单选方式记录。

sourceText:
Does the company have external assurance for its sustainability reporting? 
o Yes, the company has external assurance for its sustainability reporting. Please indicate where this information is available in public reporting or 
corporate website. 
□ 
The assurance statement is based on a recognized international or national standard (e.g. AAIOOOAS, ISAE 3000). 
□ 
The assurance statement contains a "declaration of independence" which specifies that the assurance provider has no conflict of interest in 
related to providing the assurance of environmental and/or social data for the company that has been assured. 
□ 
The scope of the assurance statement clearly indicates that it covers environmental key performance indicators (KPIs). If only some KPIs are 
assured, then it is clearly indicated which data/KPIs disclosed in the report have been assured. 
□ 
The scope of the assurance statement clearly indicates that it covers social KPIs. If only some KPIs are assured, then it is clearly indicated 
which data/KPIs disclosed in the report have been assured. 
□ 
The assurance statement contains a conclusion, i.e., either "limited assurance" or "reasonable assurance."
noteZh: 结构：题面展示一个“是”单选项，其下有位置说明字段和五个可多选的鉴证条件复选项。PDF布局未展示“否”选项，故未补入；门户完整线上分支未核实。

text.en: Does the company have external assurance for its sustainability reporting?
text.zh: 公司的可持续发展报告是否经过外部鉴证？

text.en: Yes, the company has external assurance for its sustainability reporting.
text.zh: 是，公司的可持续发展报告经过外部鉴证。

text.en: Please indicate where this information is available in public reporting or corporate website.
text.zh: 请注明该信息可在公开报告或公司网站的何处查阅。

text.en: The assurance statement is based on a recognized international or national standard (e.g. AAIOOOAS, ISAE 3000).
text.zh: 鉴证声明依据公认的国际或国家标准（例如 AA1000AS、ISAE 3000）。

text.en: The assurance statement contains a "declaration of independence" which specifies that the assurance provider has no conflict of interest in related to providing the assurance of environmental and/or social data for the company that has been assured.
text.zh: 鉴证声明包含“独立性声明”，说明鉴证提供方在为被鉴证公司提供环境和/或社会数据鉴证方面不存在利益冲突。

text.en: The scope of the assurance statement clearly indicates that it covers environmental key performance indicators (KPIs). If only some KPIs are assured, then it is clearly indicated which data/KPIs disclosed in the report have been assured.
text.zh: 鉴证声明的范围明确说明涵盖环境关键绩效指标（KPI）。如果仅鉴证部分 KPI，则须明确指出报告披露的哪些数据/KPI经过鉴证。

text.en: The scope of the assurance statement clearly indicates that it covers social KPIs. If only some KPIs are assured, then it is clearly indicated which data/KPIs disclosed in the report have been assured.
text.zh: 鉴证声明的范围明确说明涵盖社会 KPI。如果仅鉴证部分 KPI，则须明确指出报告披露的哪些数据/KPI经过鉴证。

text.en: The assurance statement contains a conclusion, i.e., either "limited assurance" or "reasonable assurance."
text.zh: 鉴证声明包含结论，即“有限保证”或“合理保证”。

sourceText:
Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors? 
 
o 
Yes, the company has an independence statement. Please indicate below what the statement includes and provide a reference: 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
The company complies with the following corporate governance code or stock exchange rules 
o 
The stock exchange the company follows is not on the list or the company has its own own stricter independence requirements. The 
requirements cover the following: 
□ 
The director must not have been employed by the company in an executive capacity within the last year. 
□ 
The director must not accept or have a “Family Member who accepts any payments from the company or any parent or subsidiary of 
the company in excess of $60,000 during the current fiscal year,” other than those permitted by SEC Rule 4200 Definitions, including 
(i) payments arising solely from investments in the company's securities; or (ii) payments under nondiscretionary charitable 
contribution matching programs. Payments that do not meet these two criteria are disallowed. 
□ 
The director must not be a “Family Member of an individual who is employed by the company or by any parent or subsidiary of the 
company as an executive officer.” 
□ 
The director must not be (and must not be affiliated with a company that is) an adviser or consultant to the company or a member of 
the company’s senior management. 
□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a significant customer or supplier of the company. 
□ 
The director must have no personal services contract(s) with the company and cannot be a member of the company’s senior 


management. 
□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a not-for-profit entity that receives significant contributions from the company. 
□ 
The director must not have been a partner or employee of the company’s outside auditor during the past year. 
□ 
The director must not have any other conflict of interest that the board itself determines to mean they cannot be considered 
independent. 
Target share 
□ 
The company has a target share of independent directors on the board. Please specify:
noteZh: PDF 第16–17页显示声明回答、公司治理规则路径和目标比例。更严格规则分支下有九项独立复选条件；目标比例仅保留“请具体说明”字段，未臆定百分比单位。 精确版面匹配当前题目 JSON 中 53 条题目记录。

text.en: Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors?
text.zh: 公司是否有董事会独立性声明？

text.en: Yes, the company has an independence statement. Please indicate below what the statement includes and provide a reference:
text.zh: 是，公司有独立性声明。请在下方注明该声明包含的内容并提供参考资料：

text.en: Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites.
text.zh: 上市公司必须提供公开报告或公司网站的链接。

text.en: Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites.
text.zh: 非上市公司必须提供内部文件和/或公开报告或公司网站的链接。

text.en: The company complies with the following corporate governance code or stock exchange rules
text.zh: 公司遵守以下公司治理准则或证券交易所规则

text.en: The stock exchange the company follows is not on the list or the company has its own own stricter independence requirements. The requirements cover the following:
text.zh: 公司遵循的证券交易所未列入名单，或公司有自身更严格的独立性要求。相关要求涵盖以下内容：

text.en: The director must not have been employed by the company in an executive capacity within the last year.
text.zh: 董事在过去一年内不得以高管身份受雇于公司。

text.en: The director must not accept or have a “Family Member who accepts any payments from the company or any parent or subsidiary of the company in excess of $60,000 during the current fiscal year,” other than those permitted by SEC Rule 4200 Definitions, including (i) payments arising solely from investments in the company's securities; or (ii) payments under nondiscretionary charitable contribution matching programs. Payments that do not meet these two criteria are disallowed.
text.zh: 董事不得接受，且不得有“家庭成员在本财政年度内从公司或公司的任何母公司或子公司接受超过60,000美元的任何款项”，但SEC Rule 4200 Definitions允许的情形除外，包括：(i) 完全源自投资公司证券的款项；或(ii) 根据非酌情慈善捐赠配捐计划支付的款项。不符合这两项标准的款项均不允许。

text.en: The director must not be a “Family Member of an individual who is employed by the company or by any parent or subsidiary of the company as an executive officer.”
text.zh: 董事不得是“受雇于公司或其任何母公司或子公司的个人的家庭成员，且该个人担任高管”。

text.en: The director must not be (and must not be affiliated with a company that is) an adviser or consultant to the company or a member of the company’s senior management.
text.zh: 董事不得是公司的顾问或咨询师，也不得隶属于担任公司顾问或咨询师的公司；董事也不得是公司高级管理层成员。

text.en: The director must not be affiliated with a significant customer or supplier of the company.
text.zh: 董事不得隶属于公司的重要客户或供应商。

text.en: The director must have no personal services contract(s) with the company and cannot be a member of the company’s senior management.
text.zh: 董事不得与公司签订个人服务合同，且不得是公司高级管理层成员。

text.en: The director must not be affiliated with a not-for-profit entity that receives significant contributions from the company.
text.zh: 董事不得隶属于从公司获得重大捐助的非营利实体。

text.en: The director must not have been a partner or employee of the company’s outside auditor during the past year.

Does the company have a policy on responsible artificial intelligence and is it available publicly? 
o 
Yes, the company has a policy on responsible artificial intelligence and it includes at least one of the following aspects. Please indicate where this 
information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
Policy aspects 
The policy covers the following aspects: 
□ 
Respecting data privacy in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Protecting the cybersecurity of systems in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Avoiding potential bias in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Keeping humans “in the loop” for critical decisions and allowing human intervention 
□ 
Ensuring transparency of AI systems and explainability of AI generated results/decisions 
□ 
Establishing clear accountability for outcomes produced by AI models/tools 
□ 
Defining clear boundaries for what the AI can and cannot do 
□ 
Requiring (own/third-party) AI data centers/models to have a low ecological footprint 
□ 
Not using/deploying AI systems that engage in manipulative behavior, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring or unauthorized biometric 
surveillance (i.e. prohibited systems as per EU AI Act) 
Policy endorsement 
□

Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks? 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
Yes, the company has governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks.  
The company has a risk governance framework with board level risk oversight: 
□ 
Dedicated role or committee at board level for risk oversight (independent and/or non-executive board member(s)) 
The company has a risk governance framework with dedicated operational risk management functions in place: 
□ 
Operational Risk Ownership (first line): Front-line employees or dedicated operational roles (e.g., risk managers, business unit heads) own 
and manage risks. 
□ 
Risk Management and Compliance Oversight (second line): A dedicated role(s) or committee(s) exist(s) at the senior management or 
executive level, which is responsible for setting control standards and oversees compliance with them (does not include the CEO). 
□ 
Independent Audit Unit (third line): An internal audit function that provides independent assurance on the effectiveness of risk management 
and compliance processes.
noteZh: 按输入中的精确英文版面及既有中文辅助译文逐标记核对；单选组只在该布局中出现完整的同题 Yes/No 两项时设置，其余保留 source-radio；下拉项保留 source-menu，未确认时不将选项设为试选值。此布局共用于 61 条题目记录；未逐条核对全部 PDF 页面。

在董事会层面设有负责风险监督的专门职务或委员会（由独立董事和/或非执行董事组成）

Operational Risk Ownership (first line): Front-line employees or dedicated operational roles (e.g., risk managers, business unit heads) own

text.zh: 运营风险责任（第一道防线）：一线员工或专门的运营岗位（例如风险经理、业务部门负责人）负责承担和管理风险。

sourceText:
Does the company have risk management processes to promote effective risk culture? 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
Yes, the company has risk management processes to promote effective risk culture.  
The risk review process include the following elements: 
□ 
Description of the company-specific risk exposure (considering likelihood and magnitude) of at least two identified risks 
□ 
Description of process or framework to determine the risk appetite for identified risks 
□ 
Description of mitigating actions for at least two identified risks. 
The company reviews its risk exposure on a regular basis: 
o 
At least twice a year or more frequently 
o 
At least yearly 
o 
Less frequently than yearly 
o 
Not specified. 
The company has conducted an audit of the risk management process. Please specify if an internal audit and/or an external audit has been 
performed: 
□ 
Yes, the company has conducted an internal audit in the last two years 
□ 
Yes, the company has conducted an external audit in the last two years 
The company has strategies in place to promote an effective risk culture throughout the organisation: 
□ 
Regular risk management education for all non-executive directors 
□ 
Focused training throughout the organization on risk management principles 
□ 
Incorporation of risk criteria in the development of products and services

Does the company integrate the TCFD framework in the management of climate-related risks and opportunities? 
o 
Yes, the company integrates the TCFD framework in the management of climate-related risks and opportunities. Please indicate where this 
information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
Governance 
□ 
a) Describe the board’s oversight of climate related risks and opportunities. 
□ 
b) Describe management’s role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities. 
Strategy 
□ 
a) Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term. 
□ 
b) Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization’s businesses, strategy, and financial planning. 
□ 
c) Describe the resilience of the organization’s strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or 
lower scenario. 
Risk management 
□ 
a) Describe the organization’s processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks. 
□ 
b) Describe the organization’s processes for managing climate-related risks. 
□ 
c) Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization’s overall risk 
management. 
Metrics & Targets 
□ 
a) Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk 
management process. 


□ 
b) Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks. 
□

data, as well as for our research purposes. Please provide information for all parts of this question. Please ensure that the figures provided in this

Reporting currency 
Please select the company's reporting currency. For consistency purposes, this currency will be used throughout the questionnaire, and will be 
automatically selected for questions asking for monetary data. If the company would like to change the default currency, it can do so by changing the 
currency selection below. Unless otherwise specified, all monetary values should be reported in their absolute values. 
Normalization factors

fluctuations in foreign exchange rates and are thus a better indicator of business performance. However, reported revenues are acceptable as 
well. Please also provide information for all other requested fields.

Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors? 
 
o 
Yes, the company has an independence statement. Please indicate below what the statement includes and provide a reference: 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
The company complies with the following corporate governance code or stock exchange rules 
o 
The stock exchange the company follows is not on the list or the company has its own own stricter independence requirements. The 
requirements cover the following: 
□ 
The director must not have been employed by the company in an executive capacity within the last year. 
□ 
The director must not accept or have a “Family Member who accepts any payments from the company or any parent or subsidiary of 
the company in excess of $60,000 during the current fiscal year,” other than those permitted by SEC Rule 4200 Definitions, including 
(i) payments arising solely from investments in the company's securities; or (ii) payments under nondiscretionary charitable 
contribution matching programs. Payments that do not meet these two criteria are disallowed. 
□ 
The director must not be a “Family Member of an individual who is employed by the company or by any parent or subsidiary of the 
company as an executive officer.” 
□ 
The director must not be (and must not be affiliated with a company that is) an adviser or consultant to the company or a member of 
the company’s senior management. 
□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a significant customer or supplier of the company. 
□ 
The director must have no personal services contract(s) with the company and cannot be a member of the company’s senior 
management. 
□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a not-for-profit entity that receives significant contributions from the company. 
□ 
The director must not have been a partner or employee of the company’s outside auditor during the past year. 
□ 
The director must not have any other conflict of interest that the board itself determines to mean they cannot be considered 
independent.

Does the company have mitigating actions to reduce impact and dependency on biodiversity? 
o 
Yes, the company has mitigating actions to reduce biodiversity impact and dependency. Please indicate where this information is available 
in public reporting or corporate website. 
□ 
Avoid: Measures which prevent impact or dependency from happening in the first place; eliminate the impact entirely 
□ 
Reduce: Measures which minimize impacts, but without necessarily eliminating them 
□ 
Regenerate: Measures which improve existing processes’ biophysical function and productivity of an ecosystem or its components 
□ 
Restore: Measures which initiate or accelerate the recovery of an ecosystem with respect to its health, integrity, and sustainability, with a 
focus on permanent changes in state 
□ 
Transform: Measures which take actions contributing to system-wide change, notably to alter the drivers of nature loss, e.g., through 
technological, economic, institutional, and social factors and changes in underlying values and behaviours.

sourceText:
Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks? 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
Yes, the company has governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks.  
The company has a risk governance framework with board level risk oversight: 
□ 
Dedicated role or committee at board level for risk oversight (independent and/or non-executive board member(s)) 
The company has a risk governance framework with dedicated operational risk management functions in place: 
□ 
Operational Risk Ownership (first line): Front-line employees or dedicated operational roles (e.g., risk managers, business unit heads) own 
and manage risks. 
□ 
Risk Management and Compliance Oversight (second line): A dedicated role(s) or committee(s) exist(s) at the senior management or 
executive level, which is responsible for setting control standards and oversees compliance with them (does not include the CEO). 
□ 
Independent Audit Unit (third line): An internal audit function that provides independent assurance on the effectiveness of risk management 


and compliance processes.
noteZh: 按源文本和既有译文恢复董事会监督与运营风险管理两层标题；第一、第二、第三道防线保留为各自复选项，不合并。

text.en: Does the company have governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks?
text.zh: 公司是否建立了监督风险的治理机制？

text.en: Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites.
text.zh: 上市公司必须提供公开报告或公司网站的链接。非上市公司必须提供内部文件和/或公开报告或公司网站的链接。

text.en: Yes, the company has governance mechanisms in place to oversee risks.
text.zh: 是，公司已建立监督风险的治理机制。

text.en: The company has a risk governance framework with board level risk oversight:
text.zh: 公司建立了风险治理框架，并由董事会层面监督风险：

text.en: Dedicated role or committee at board level for risk oversight (independent and/or non-executive board member(s))
text.zh: 在董事会层面设有负责风险监督的专门职务或委员会（由独立董事和/或非执行董事组成）

text.en: The company has a risk governance framework with dedicated operational risk management functions in place:
text.zh: 公司建立了风险治理框架，并设有专门的运营风险管理职能：

text.en: Operational Risk Ownership (first line): Front-line employees or dedicated operational roles (e.g., risk managers, business unit heads) own and manage risks.
text.zh: 运营风险责任（第一道防线）：一线员工或专门的运营岗位（例如风险经理、业务部门负责人）负责承担和管理风险。

text.en: Risk Management and Compliance Oversight (second line): A dedicated role(s) or committee(s) exist(s) at the senior management or executive level, which is responsible for setting control standards and oversees compliance with them (does not include the CEO).

Does the company have a policy on responsible artificial intelligence and is it available publicly? 


o 
Yes, the company has a policy on responsible artificial intelligence and it includes at least one of the following aspects. Please indicate where this 
information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
Policy aspects 
The policy covers the following aspects: 
□ 
Respecting data privacy in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Protecting the cybersecurity of systems in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Avoiding potential bias in the use and/or development of AI 
□ 
Keeping humans “in the loop” for critical decisions and allowing human intervention 
□ 
Ensuring transparency of AI systems and explainability of AI generated results/decisions 
□ 
Establishing clear accountability for outcomes produced by AI models/tools 
□ 
Defining clear boundaries for what the AI can and cannot do 
□ 
Requiring (own/third-party) AI data centers/models to have a low ecological footprint 
□ 
Not using/deploying AI systems that engage in manipulative behavior, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring or unauthorized biometric 
surveillance (i.e. prohibited systems as per EU AI Act) 
Policy endorsement 
□ 
Please select the highest endorsing decision-making body: 
o 
Board of directors 
o 
Executive management
noteZh: 按源文本和既有译文恢复九项政策复选及最高批准机构选择；董事会/执行管理层为同一互斥组。

text.en:
Policy aspects
The policy covers the following aspects:
text.zh:
政策方面
该政策涵盖以下方面：

text.en: Respecting data privacy in the use and/or development of AI
text.zh: 在使用和/或开发人工智能时尊重数据隐私

text.en: Protecting the cybersecurity of systems in the use and/or development of AI
text.zh: 在使用和/或开发人工智能时保护系统网络安全

text.en: Avoiding potential bias in the use and/or development of AI
text.zh: 避免在使用和/或开发人工智能时产生潜在偏见

text.en: Keeping humans “in the loop” for critical decisions and allowing human intervention
text.zh: 在关键决策中保持人在决策环节并允许人工干预

text.en: Ensuring transparency of AI systems and explainability of AI generated results/decisions
text.zh: 确保人工智能系统透明，并使人工智能生成的结果/决策具有可解释性

text.en: Establishing clear accountability for outcomes produced by AI models/tools
text.zh: 明确人工智能模型/工具产出结果的问责责任

text.en: Defining clear boundaries for what the AI can and cannot do
text.zh: 明确界定人工智能能做和不能做的事项

text.en: Requiring (own/third-party) AI data centers/models to have a low ecological footprint
text.zh: 要求自有/第三方人工智能数据中心/模型具有较低的生态足迹

text.en: Not using/deploying AI systems that engage in manipulative behavior, exploitation of vulnerabilities, social scoring or unauthorized biometric surveillance (i.e. prohibited systems as per EU AI Act)

o 
Yes, the company has a program for sustainable products or services. Please indicate where this information is available in public reporting or 
corporate website 
The sustainable products program contains the following elements: 


□ 
Classification system to define sustainable or "green" products is based on specific and quantified benefits (e.g. EU Taxonomy, other 
taxonomies, own classification system) 
□ 
External verification of the sustainable products or services classification 
□ 
Specific, time-bound and quantified target for increasing revenues from sustainable products and services, or number of sustainable 
products and services 
□ 
Investments made (CAPEX, OPEX) to increase sustainable products or services portfolio 
□ 
R&D resources to develop sustainable products or services 
□ 
Infrastructure improvements to ensure products and services are produced/manufactured/maintained sustainably 
□ 
Internal training on sustainable design principles for functions developing products or services (e.g. R&D, innovation) 
□ 
Incentives for sales staff on sustainable products or services

text.en: The sustainable products program contains the following elements:
text.zh: 可持续产品计划包含以下要素：

text.en: Classification system to define sustainable or "green" products is based on specific and quantified benefits (e.g. EU Taxonomy, other taxonomies, own classification system)

text.en: External verification of the sustainable products or services classification
text.zh: 对可持续产品或服务分类进行外部核验

text.en: Specific, time-bound and quantified target for increasing revenues from sustainable products and services, or number of sustainable products and services
text.zh: 设定具体、有时限且可量化的目标，以增加可持续产品和服务的收入或数量

text.en: Investments made (CAPEX, OPEX) to increase sustainable products or services portfolio
text.zh: 为扩大可持续产品或服务组合所作的投资（CAPEX、OPEX）

text.en: R&D resources to develop sustainable products or services
text.zh: 用于开发可持续产品或服务的研发（R&D）资源

text.en: Infrastructure improvements to ensure products and services are produced/manufactured/maintained sustainably
text.zh: 改进基础设施，以确保产品和服务以可持续方式生产/制造/维护

text.en: Internal training on sustainable design principles for functions developing products or services (e.g. R&D, innovation)

Commitment aspects 
The commitment covers the following aspects: 
□ 
A commitment to compliance with the spirit as well as the letter of the tax laws and regulations in the countries in which the company 
operates 
□ 
A commitment to not transfer value created to low-tax jurisdictions 
□ 
A commitment to not use tax structures without commercial substance 
□ 
A commitment to undertake transfer pricing using the arm’s length principle 
□ 
A commitment not to use secrecy jurisdictions or so-called tax havens for tax avoidance

Does the company have publicly available policies or procedures in place to ensure the effective establishment and implementation of a company 
culture opposing money-laundering and terrorism financing?  
o 
Yes, the company has publicly available policies or procedures in place to ensure the effective establishment and implementation of a company 
culture opposing money-laundering and terrorism financing. Please indicate where this information is available in the public 
reporting or corporate website. 
□ 
Customer due diligence (CDD): formal policies and procedures include customer verification based on reliable, independent source 
documents, data or information, identification of the beneficial owner, or conducting ongoing due diligence on business relationships 
□ 
Non-face-to-face CDD: formal policies and procedures are in place for non-face-to-face customers including, amongst other measures, 
certification of documents presented and independent contact with the customer by the bank 
□ 
Terrorist financing: CDD procedures include formal searches against lists of known or suspected terrorists issued by competent authorities 
having jurisdiction over the relevant financial institution 
□ 
Politically exposed persons (PEPs): formal policy and procedures in place covering the identification, periodical review and monitoring of 
PEPs 
□ 
Senior management to sign off PEP customers or other customers from countries, businesses and products with the greatest risk of money-
laundering/terrorism financing 
□ 
Record keeping for all anti-money-laundering/terrorism financing-related documents. Please indicate the number of years: 
□ 
Annual independent assessment of monitoring procedures.

culture opposing money-laundering and terrorism financing.

Customer due diligence (CDD): formal policies and procedures include customer verification based on reliable, independent source
documents, data or information, identification of the beneficial owner, or conducting ongoing due diligence on business relationships
text.zh: 客户尽职调查（CDD）：正式政策和程序包括依据可靠、独立的来源文件、数据或信息核验客户身份，识别受益所有人，或对业务关系开展持续尽职调查

certification of documents presented and independent contact with the customer by the bank
text.zh: 非面对面 CDD：针对非面对面客户制定了正式政策和程序，其中包括但不限于对所提交文件进行认证，以及由银行独立联系客户

having jurisdiction over the relevant financial institution

Does the company integrate the TCFD framework in the management of climate-related risks and opportunities? 
o 
Yes, the company integrates the TCFD framework in the management of climate-related risks and opportunities. Please indicate where this 
information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
Governance 
□ 
a) Describe the board’s oversight of climate related risks and opportunities. 
□ 
b) Describe management’s role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities. 
Strategy 
□ 
a) Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term. 
□ 
b) Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization’s businesses, strategy, and financial planning. 
□ 
c) Describe the resilience of the organization’s strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or 
lower scenario. 
Risk management 
□ 
a) Describe the organization’s processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks. 
□ 
b) Describe the organization’s processes for managing climate-related risks. 
□ 
c) Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization’s overall risk 
management. 
Metrics & Targets 
□ 
a) Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk 
management process. 
□ 
b) Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks. 
□ 
c) Describe the targets used by the organization to manage climate-related risks and opportunities and performance against targets. 
o 
No, the company does not integrate the TCFD framework but publicly commits to integrating its requirements. Please indicate when it plans to 
disclose these requirements.

Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors? 
 
o 
Yes, the company has an independence statement. Please indicate below what the statement includes and provide a reference: 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
The company complies with the following corporate governance code or stock exchange rules 
o 
The stock exchange the company follows is not on the list or the company has its own own stricter independence requirements. The 
requirements cover the following: 
□ 
The director must not have been employed by the company in an executive capacity within the last year. 
□ 
The director must not accept or have a “Family Member who accepts any payments from the company or any parent or subsidiary of 
the company in excess of $60,000 during the current fiscal year,” other than those permitted by SEC Rule 4200 Definitions, including (i) 
payments arising solely from investments in the company's securities; or (ii) payments under nondiscretionary charitable contribution 
matching programs. Payments that do not meet these two criteria are disallowed. 
□ 
The director must not be a “Family Member of an individual who is employed by the company or by any parent or subsidiary of the 
company as an executive officer.” 
□ 
The director must not be (and must not be affiliated with a company that is) an adviser or consultant to the company or a member of 
the company’s senior management. 
□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a significant customer or supplier of the company. 
□ 
The director must have no personal services contract(s) with the company and cannot be a member of the company’s senior 
management. 


□ 
The director must not be affiliated with a not-for-profit entity that receives significant contributions from the company. 
□ 
The director must not have been a partner or employee of the company’s outside auditor during the past year. 
□ 
The director must not have any other conflict of interest that the board itself determines to mean they cannot be considered 
independent. 
Target share 
□ 
The company has a target share of independent directors on the board. Please specify:

text.en: Does the company have an independence statement for the board of directors?
text.zh: 公司是否有董事会独立性声明？

text.en:
Yes, the company has an independence statement. Please indicate below what the statement includes and provide a reference:
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites.
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites.
text.zh:
是，公司有独立性声明。请在下方注明该声明包含的内容并提供参考资料：
上市公司必须提供公开报告或公司网站的链接。
非上市公司必须提供内部文件和/或公开报告或公司网站的链接。

text.en: The company complies with the following corporate governance code or stock exchange rules
text.zh: 公司遵守以下公司治理准则或证券交易所规则

text.en:
The stock exchange the company follows is not on the list or the company has its own own stricter independence requirements. The
requirements cover the following:
text.zh: 公司遵循的证券交易所未列入名单，或公司有自身更严格的独立性要求。相关要求涵盖以下内容：

text.en: The director must not have been employed by the company in an executive capacity within the last year.
text.zh: 董事在过去一年内不得以高管身份受雇于公司。

text.en:
The director must not accept or have a “Family Member who accepts any payments from the company or any parent or subsidiary of
the company in excess of $60,000 during the current fiscal year,” other than those permitted by SEC Rule 4200 Definitions, including (i)
payments arising solely from investments in the company's securities; or (ii) payments under nondiscretionary charitable contribution
matching programs. Payments that do not meet these two criteria are disallowed.
text.zh: 董事不得接受，且不得有“家庭成员在本财政年度内从公司或公司的任何母公司或子公司接受超过60,000美元的任何款项”，但SEC Rule 4200 Definitions允许的情形除外，包括：(i) 完全源自投资公司证券的款项；或(ii) 根据非酌情慈善捐赠配捐计划支付的款项。不符合这两项标准的款项均不允许。

text.en:
The director must not be a “Family Member of an individual who is employed by the company or by any parent or subsidiary of the
company as an executive officer.”
text.zh: 董事不得是“受雇于公司或其任何母公司或子公司的个人的家庭成员，且该个人担任高管”。

text.en:
The director must not be (and must not be affiliated with a company that is) an adviser or consultant to the company or a member of
the company’s senior management.
text.zh: 董事不得是公司的顾问或咨询师，也不得隶属于担任公司顾问或咨询师的公司；董事也不得是公司高级管理层成员。

text.en: The director must not be affiliated with a significant customer or supplier of the company.
text.zh: 董事不得隶属于公司的重要客户或供应商。

text.en:
The director must have no personal services contract(s) with the company and cannot be a member of the company’s senior
management.
text.zh: 董事不得与公司签订个人服务合同，且不得是公司高级管理层成员。

text.en: The director must not be affiliated with a not-for-profit entity that receives significant contributions from the company.
text.zh: 董事不得隶属于从公司获得重大捐助的非营利实体。

text.en: The director must not have been a partner or employee of the company’s outside auditor during the past year.
text.zh: 董事在过去一年内不得是公司外部审计师事务所的合伙人或员工。

text.en:
The director must not have any other conflict of interest that the board itself determines to mean they cannot be considered
independent.
text.zh: 董事不得存在董事会自身认定会导致其不符合独立董事资格的任何其他利益冲突。

text.zh: 公司为董事会独立董事设定了目标比例。请具体说明：

Does the company have risk management processes to promote effective risk culture? 
Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites. 
Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites. 
o 
Yes, the company has risk management processes to promote effective risk culture.  
The risk review process include the following elements: 
□ 
Description of the company-specific risk exposure (considering likelihood and magnitude) of at least two identified risks 
□ 
Description of process or framework to determine the risk appetite for identified risks 
□ 
Description of mitigating actions for at least two identified risks. 
The company reviews its risk exposure on a regular basis: 
o 
At least twice a year or more frequently 
o 
At least yearly 
o 
Less frequently than yearly 
o 
Not specified. 
The company has conducted an audit of the risk management process. Please specify if an internal audit and/or an external audit has been 
performed: 
□ 
Yes, the company has conducted an internal audit in the last two years 
□ 
Yes, the company has conducted an external audit in the last two years 
The company has strategies in place to promote an effective risk culture throughout the organisation: 
□ 
Regular risk management education for all non-executive directors 


□ 
Focused training throughout the organization on risk management principles 
□ 
Incorporation of risk criteria in the development of products and services 
□ 
Financial incentives which incorporate risk management metrics

text.en: Does the company have risk management processes to promote effective risk culture?
text.zh: 公司是否设有风险管理流程，以促进形成有效的风险文化？

text.en: Listed companies are required to provide links to public reports or corporate websites.
text.zh: 上市公司须提供公开报告或公司网站的链接。

text.en: Non-listed companies are required to provide internal documents and/or links to public reports or corporate websites.

text.en: Yes, the company has risk management processes to promote effective risk culture.
text.zh: 是，公司设有风险管理流程，以促进形成有效的风险文化。

text.en: The risk review process include the following elements:
text.zh: 风险审查流程包括以下要素：

text.en: Description of the company-specific risk exposure (considering likelihood and magnitude) of at least two identified risks
text.zh: 描述至少两项已识别风险的公司特定风险敞口（考虑可能性和影响程度）

text.en: Description of process or framework to determine the risk appetite for identified risks
text.zh: 描述确定已识别风险风险偏好的流程或框架

text.en: Description of mitigating actions for at least two identified risks.
text.zh: 描述至少两项已识别风险的缓解措施。

text.en: The company reviews its risk exposure on a regular basis:
text.zh: 公司定期审查其风险敞口：

text.en: At least twice a year or more frequently
text.zh: 每年至少两次或更频繁

text.en: At least yearly
text.zh: 至少每年一次

text.en: Less frequently than yearly
text.zh: 少于每年一次

text.en: Not specified.
text.zh: 未说明。

text.en:
The company has conducted an audit of the risk management process. Please specify if an internal audit and/or an external audit has been
performed:
text.zh: 公司已对风险管理流程进行审计。请注明是否开展了内部审计和/或外部审计：

text.en: Yes, the company has conducted an internal audit in the last two years
text.zh: 是，公司在过去两年内开展了内部审计

text.en: Yes, the company has conducted an external audit in the last two years
text.zh: 是，公司在过去两年内开展了外部审计

text.en: The company has strategies in place to promote an effective risk culture throughout the organisation:
text.zh: 公司制定了在整个组织内促进有效风险文化的策略：

text.en: Regular risk management education for all non-executive directors
text.zh: 定期为所有非执行董事提供风险管理教育

text.en: Focused training throughout the organization on risk management principles
text.zh: 在整个组织内开展以风险管理原则为重点的培训

text.en: Incorporation of risk criteria in the development of products and services
text.zh: 在产品和服务开发过程中纳入风险标准

text.en: Financial incentives which incorporate risk management metrics
text.zh: 财务激励中纳入风险管理指标

text.en: Governance
text.zh: 治理

text.en: a) Describe the board’s oversight of climate related risks and opportunities.
text.zh: a) 描述董事会对气候相关风险和机遇的监督。

text.en: b) Describe management’s role in assessing and managing climate-related risks and opportunities.
text.zh: b) 描述管理层在评估和管理气候相关风险和机遇方面的职责。

text.en: Strategy
text.zh: 战略

text.en: a) Describe the climate-related risks and opportunities the organization has identified over the short, medium, and long term.
text.zh: a) 描述组织在短期、中期和长期内识别出的气候相关风险和机遇。

text.en: b) Describe the impact of climate-related risks and opportunities on the organization’s businesses, strategy, and financial planning.
text.zh: b) 描述气候相关风险和机遇对组织业务、战略和财务规划的影响。

text.en: c) Describe the resilience of the organization’s strategy, taking into consideration different climate-related scenarios, including a 2°C or lower scenario.
text.zh: c) 描述组织战略的韧性，并考虑不同的气候相关情景，包括 2°C 或更低温升情景。

text.en: Risk management
text.zh: 风险管理

text.en: a) Describe the organization’s processes for identifying and assessing climate-related risks.
text.zh: a) 描述组织识别和评估气候相关风险的流程。

text.en: b) Describe the organization’s processes for managing climate-related risks.
text.zh: b) 描述组织管理气候相关风险的流程。

text.en: c) Describe how processes for identifying, assessing, and managing climate-related risks are integrated into the organization’s overall risk management.
text.zh: c) 描述识别、评估和管理气候相关风险的流程如何纳入组织的整体风险管理。

text.en: Metrics & Targets
text.zh: 指标与目标

text.en: a) Disclose the metrics used by the organization to assess climate-related risks and opportunities in line with its strategy and risk management process.
text.zh: a) 披露组织用于评估气候相关风险和机遇的指标，这些指标应与其战略和风险管理流程一致。

text.en: b) Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks.
text.zh: b) 披露范围 1、范围 2，以及适用时的范围 3 温室气体（GHG）排放及相关风险。

text.en: c) Describe the targets used by the organization to manage climate-related risks and opportunities and performance against targets.
text.zh: c) 描述组织用于管理气候相关风险和机遇的目标，以及相对于目标的绩效。

text.zh: 否，公司未纳入 TCFD 框架，但公开承诺将纳入其要求。请注明公司计划何时披露这些要求。

well. Please also provide information for all other requested fields.

Does the company report on animal welfare-related data and objectives related to their own operations or commitments from suppliers? 
o 
Yes, the company reports on animal welfare-related data and objectives related to their own operations or commitments from suppliers. Please 
indicate where this information is available in public reporting or corporate website. 
□ 
The company discloses the application of antibiotics and its commitment to minimize the routine application of antibiotics for prophylactic 
purposes in its animal production operations, or it publicly request such disclosure and commitment from its suppliers.  
□ 
The company discloses its commitment not to use genetically modified or cloned animals or it publicly request such a commitment from its 
suppliers.  
□ 
The company discloses its commitment not to apply growth-promoting substances, such as hormones, to animals or request such a 
commitment from its suppliers.  
 
□ 
The company discloses that it audits its own animal production operations (externally or by internal means at least once every three years) 
or request such a disclosure from its suppliers.  
□ 
The company discloses other animal welfare-related data or commitments, such as a commitment not to use gestation stalls or a pledge to 
only produce cage-free eggs.
noteZh: 已视觉核对 PDF 第204–205页。肯定分支有5项彼此独立的动物福利数据/承诺复选项，保留各项中的 not、at least once every three years、or 等限定。

text.en: Does the company report on animal welfare-related data and objectives related to their own operations or commitments from suppliers?
text.zh: 公司是否报告与其自身运营相关的动物福利数据和目标，或供应商作出的承诺？

text.en: Yes, the company reports on animal welfare-related data and objectives related to their own operations or commitments from suppliers. Please indicate where this information is available in public reporting or corporate website.
text.zh: 是，公司报告与其自身运营相关的动物福利数据和目标，或供应商作出的承诺。请注明该信息可在何处查阅（公开报告或公司网站）。

text.en: The company discloses the application of antibiotics and its commitment to minimize the routine application of antibiotics for prophylactic purposes in its animal production operations, or it publicly request such disclosure and commitment from its suppliers.
text.zh: 公司披露其动物生产运营中抗生素的使用情况，并承诺尽量减少常规使用抗生素进行预防，或公开要求供应商作出此类披露并承诺。

text.en: The company discloses its commitment not to use genetically modified or cloned animals or it publicly request such a commitment from its suppliers.
text.zh: 公司披露其不使用转基因或克隆动物的承诺，或公开要求供应商作出此类承诺。

text.en: The company discloses its commitment not to apply growth-promoting substances, such as hormones, to animals or request such a commitment from its suppliers.
text.zh: 公司披露其不对动物使用激素等促生长物质的承诺，或要求供应商作出此类承诺。

text.en: The company discloses that it audits its own animal production operations (externally or by internal means at least once every three years) or request such a disclosure from its suppliers.
text.zh: 公司披露其对自身动物生产运营进行审计（外部审计，或至少每三年一次的内部审计），或要求供应商作出此类披露。

text.en: The company discloses other animal welfare-related data or commitments, such as a commitment not to use gestation stalls or a pledge to only produce cage-free eggs.
text.zh: 公司披露其他动物福利相关数据或承诺，例如承诺不使用妊娠限位栏，或承诺只生产非笼养鸡蛋。
